name: Bailiff of the Forum
description: Guardian of the Forum of Azor who delivered the Supreme Verdict and declared Jace the new Guildpact.

description_citations.text: "Implicit Maze". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace discovers the Bailiff and learns of the Supreme Verdict; Lazav also speaks to the Bailiff.
timeline.quote: As Jace left, Lazav also spoke to the bailiff to learn its secrets.

citation.text: "Forum of Azor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Bailiff pronounces the Supreme Verdict; Jace links the runners' minds to prevent catastrophe and is named the new Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: the bailiff named Jace the new Living Guildpact

citation.text: "Forum of Azor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The bailiff delivers the Supreme Verdict to every runner; Jace connects the ten minds to prevent its casting, unraveling his own mind.
timeline.quote: Jace connected the ten minds of the runners to prevent any from casting the verdict.

citation.text: "Implicit Maze", section "The race in the maze". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The bailiff eases Jace's burden and declares him the new Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Fortunately, the bailiff assisted him, easing the burden he had put upon himself.

citation.text: "Implicit Maze", section "The race in the maze". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: a magically constructed intelligence left behind by Azor himself
